## Why this code is public

It is published so you can read it, audit it, learn from it, report bugs
against it, and verify what the official binaries do. **Source-available is not
open source.** No open-source license is granted here, and none should be
inferred from the fact that the code is visible.

4. **Create a competing product** from it, in whole or in part. This includes a
